X is Siddharth Khosla. He named the band Goldspot because it was one his favourite drinks as a kid. And he missed it and it was his way of remembering the drink.
He is now a composer composing music for a lot of shows.
Ina MIna Dika he did as a side project and got picked up and was featured in a movie by Asif Mandvia.
Remember him from Only Murders In the Building intro. Loved it!
The movie is called “Today’s Special”. Their version of Ina Mina DIka is a nice fun one.

Q. In the mid-18th century, a French Vicomte served as the Controller-General of Finance under Louis XV. While he likely never left the bureaucratic salons of Paris, his name was bestowed upon X during a 1756 annexation. Today, X - the smallest territory in its continent by population - has transitioned from a colonial outpost to a global pioneer in environmental finance. In 2018, it made history by launching the world’s first sovereign financial instrument specifically designed to fund marine conservation and sustainable fisheries. Identify the specific color-coded name Y given to this 2018 sovereign bond aimed at protecting the nation's vast oceanic territory.
